bugs.title: Wallet notifications did not deeplink to wallet history; top-up created no notification
bugs.steps: Top up or withdraw from the wallet panel; click the resulting notification.
bugs.expected: Top-up and withdrawal create a notification that opens the wallet transaction history.
bugs.actual: Top-up created no notification; withdraw notification did not deeplink to wallet history.
bugs.fix: Added a central resolver (lib/notificationTarget.ts: resolveNotificationTarget / walletHistoryLink / shiftLink). WalletPanel now pushes a UserTopUp notification and a wallet-history link on both top-up and withdraw, deduped per ledger entry id. Dashboards handle ?modal=wallet (cold load + same-route event) and open the WalletPanel ledger modal via an openLedgerSignal prop.

bugs.title: Deposit-paid / wage-release notifications lacked wallet-history deeplinks and dedup keys
bugs.steps: Confirm a shift / auto-release / deposit; observe the notification target.
bugs.expected: Wage release → worker wallet history; deposit paid → employer wallet history; no duplicates on repeat sync.
bugs.actual: Wage release opened the income modal; deposit produced no notification; auto-release lacked dedup keys.
bugs.fix: confirmCompletion + auto-release wage notifications now link to ?modal=wallet with dedupeKeys; simulateDeposit emits a new EmployerDepositPaid notification (dedupe per shift) linking to employer wallet history; ApplicationExpired/Rejected links improved.

bugs.title: Insufficient deposit only showed a toast and lost flow context
bugs.steps: Create a shift with an empty wallet; click 'Xác nhận đã thanh toán'.
bugs.expected: A modal offering 'Nạp tiền ngay / Lưu nháp / Quay lại chỉnh sửa'; the draft is preserved; after top-up the employer can confirm without retyping.
bugs.actual: Only a toast appeared; no top-up path; user lost context.
bugs.fix: On INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE the new-shift page opens a modal with the three actions. 'Nạp tiền ngay' opens an inline top-up modal that preserves the pending deposit draft (createdShiftId/depositAmount stay set); after top-up the deposit-confirm card is still mounted so the employer confirms without re-entering the form. The Draft was already persisted on submit and is excluded from the public listing.

bugs.title: Avatar/logo initials inconsistent (QP vs single Q/P)
bugs.steps: Compare the top-right avatar with the dashboard welcome card.
bugs.expected: Consistent initials everywhere (e.g. 'QP' for Quán Phở Hà, 'NV' for Nguyễn Văn An).
bugs.actual: Dashboards used name.charAt(0) (single letter) while UserAvatar used a 2-letter rule.
bugs.fix: Added lib/initials.ts (getUserInitials) as the single global rule: first letter of the first two words, uppercased, diacritics preserved. UserAvatar and both dashboard welcome cards now use it.

bugs.title: Numeric-only fields accepted letters (SĐT người phụ trách tại chỗ)
bugs.steps: Type letters into the on-site contact phone / register phone / headcount.
bugs.expected: Letters rejected; digits only; clear error on invalid phone.
bugs.fix: Added sanitizePhoneInput / digitsOnly / containsLetters to lib/validate.ts. ShiftForm contact phone + register phone strip on input (inputMode=numeric) and validate via isValidVNPhone; headcount is digits-only. Wage / top-up / withdraw already strip non-digits.

bugs.title: Absent action not dimmed for checked-in workers; no late-arrival correction
bugs.steps: Worker checks in; employer views attendance. Mark a worker absent, then they arrive late.
bugs.expected: 'Đánh dấu vắng mặt' dimmed with reason for checked-in workers; employer can change absent→present with a reason (timeline + notify + safe wallet/rep restore).
bugs.actual: Absent button simply hidden for checked-in; no way to correct a wrongful absent.
bugs.fix: Added a disabled 'Đánh dấu vắng mặt' with reason for checked-in workers. Added applicationStore.revertNoShowToPresent(reason): restores +20 reputation (clamped), decrements noShowCount, reclaims the boost credit, re-fills the position, restores escrow/shift to InProgress, flips to CheckedIn, logs timeline, notifies the worker. Blocked with DISPUTE_OPEN when an open dispute exists (admin must resolve) — documented safe behavior.

bugs.title: Feedback list too basic: no sort, date-only timestamp, no report flow
bugs.steps: Open employer reviews; try to sort / report a review.
bugs.expected: Sort (newest/oldest/highest/lowest/with-comment), full timestamp (date+time+seconds), rating summary + star distribution, 'Báo cáo đánh giá' that notifies admin and flags 'Đang được xem xét' without deleting the review.
bugs.actual: Date-only timestamp, fixed newest sort, no report flow.
bugs.fix: Rebuilt EmployerFeedbackList with sort chips, formatLogDateTime, average+count+star distribution, and a report modal wired to a new reviewReportStore (notifies admins, flags review, never deletes, dedupes per reporter). Admin disputes tab shows a ReportedReviewsCard with reporter/reason/content + Reviewed/Dismissed. Worker rating history timestamp upgraded to date+time+seconds.

bugs.title: Build type error surfaced during validation: NotificationKind needed UserTopUp / EmployerDepositPaid / ReviewReported
bugs.actual: New notification kinds were pushed before being added to the NotificationKind union.
bugs.fix: Added UserTopUp, EmployerDepositPaid, ReviewReported to NotificationKind + their i18n labels. Build is clean, 28 routes.

bugs.title: Schema bump (9→10) broke two export/import version assertions
bugs.actual: phase10cStab1Batch2 hardcoded version 9 in two assertions.
bugs.fix: Imported SCHEMA_VERSION and used it in both the export-version assertion and the missing-payload-keys test. e2e/fixtures/constants.ts SCHEMA_VERSION bumped to 10 + reviewReports key added; seed.ts carries the new slice.

notABug.title: Worker shows two 'Ca làm đã kết thúc' notifications
notABug.finding: Carried over from CS6 — the two are for DIFFERENT shifts with distinct dedupeKeys (ShiftEnded:appA vs ShiftEnded:appB), and worker+employer copies go to different userIds. Re-verified: dedup is keyed per (userId, dedupeKey); two distinct shifts legitimately produce two notifications (allowed by Part 1.4).
